title: DEPHYRIER Moren Cangku (Default Repo First)
style: scope-first pulse 100 bpm trilingual EN ZH FR DEPHYRIER signature default-repo-required scope-before-action minimal-kick spoken-mandarin ledger-tone
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Please set a default repository for yourself it said
The agent landed without a project to thread
A bot in the channel is not a bot at work
No repo no scope just a name in the murk

[Pre-Chorus — Mandarin pinyin]
Mòrèn cángkù wei shèzhì
(Default repository not set)
Fānwéi wei míngquè jìnzhǐ
(Scope not clear stop)

[Chorus — Trilingual]
DEPHYRIER no default repo no work
Mòrèn cángkù shèzhì jiù kǎishǐ
(Default repo set then begin)
Pas de dépôt pas de tâche
(No repo no task)

[Verse 2]
Mention me in a channel describe the task in line
But without the scope set the verb has no spine
Repo first scope second action third clean
Skipping step one means nothing is seen

[Bridge — French]
Le dépôt avant la mention sinon le vide
(The repo before the mention otherwise the void)
Le scope est la base le reste suit le guide
(The scope is the base the rest follows the guide)

[Outro — Trilingual]
DEPHYRIER repo first scope first sane
Mòrèn cángkù sin scope no
DEPHYRIER pas de dépôt pas d'acte
